data.gender_notes: Sambhav is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sambhav is recorded with the meaning “Born or Existing”. Sambhav is a Hindu name meaning “Born or Existing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: संभव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the root 'bhava' which means 'to be', 'to exist', 'to become', 'to grow'.

in_hindi.name: संभव
in_hindi.long_meaning: संतुष्ट - Content, Satisfied, Pleased. प्रकट - Manifest, Clear, Obvious, Explicit. अतिरिक्त - Beyond, Extra, Additional.

in_tamil.name: ஸம்பவ்
in_tamil.meaning: உம்மதில் விரும்பினது, கொண்டுகிழ்ச்சியில் இருக்கும், உம்மிடம் இருக்கும்
in_tamil.long_meaning: உம்மதில் - In our own self. விரும்பினது - Existing, Present. கொண்டுகிழ்ச்சியில் - In our possession. உம்மிடம் - In us.

in_telugu.name: శంభవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: పోయే - Present, Existent. మొదెదే - Accessible, Reachable. ఉచిత - Belonging, Own, Personal. ఉచితమోదు - Near, Close, Proximate.

in_marathi.name: Sambhav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born or Existing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sambhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The One Who Is Born or Exists

in_bengali.name: Sambhav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Born or Existing
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sambhav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The One Who Is Born or Exists
